laws.rule: The regional tourism authority sets a civil-tourism code and keeps a record of visitors' uncivilised conduct (article 62). Travel agencies must tell tour members to follow the code and must step in when a member breaks it (article 37). Scenic areas set a maximum visitor load and publish live numbers in peak season (article 28), and dangerous activities such as horse riding, camel riding, rafting, desert surfing and alpine skiing must be done at insured, registered operators after a safety briefing (article 43).
laws.penalty_signal: No fine on the visitor is set in the article read; breaches fall under the other laws that apply.
laws.heading: 内蒙古自治区旅游条例 (Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Tourism Regulation)

laws.rule: Hohhot: visitors must follow the law and public manners, protect tourism resources, the environment and relics, look after facilities, respect local ethnic customs and religion, and keep to tourism order and safety and health rules (article 32).
laws.penalty_signal: No fine on the visitor is set in the article read; breaches fall under the other laws that apply.
